description: Tick or untick modules and options, then regenerate the document (the Datenschutz tab over the API). Merges into the stored selection; unknown module or option keys are refused. Sections tied to a switch (Einwilligungsnachweis, Barrierefreiheits-Werkzeug) follow that switch and are not ticked here. Requires cvrt-legal 0.7.0+.

doc.description: Generated document: impressum, datenschutz or barrierefreiheit (BFSG statement, cvrt-legal 0.9.0+)

keep.description: slugs of sections added through the API that survive regeneration
